correctness.rationale: PASS: PSD zero forcing is applied componentwise in the white induced subgraph. A white-edge cycle in K_n cannot be broken by a blue K_n edge, since any blue edge meeting the cycle sees both incident white cycle edges in the same component. A spanning tree (one ground component) has no initial force. Conversely, if white graph F is disconnected forest, any white leaf u in a nontrivial component C and w outside C give a blue edge uw with precisely one white neighbor uv in white component L(C); induction removes all edges. Thus B succeeds iff F is forest with >=2 ground components for all n>=3, including empty F. Cayley exponential set partitions enumerate all forest sizes; independent Python computed exact 2-component minimum counts n=3..8 as 3,15,110,1080,13377,200704. Reviewed independent PSD simulator in check_psd.py and forest counter in check_forest_counts.py, but infinite theorem rests on structural proof rather than bounded enumeration.
